notes.title: LOONEWS 7 | Erogoddess: Mirage Released & 69 Summon Succubus Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/d41f9d1a2127f3e3b333eae8217c72c640f19c1a.png

Dear friends Erogoddess: Mirage is now available! Dating simulator with feminized Egyptian gods. Ra, Anubis, Seth, Osiris, Horus and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune. In the near future we will give away 10 keys to the game in our Discord!

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/be825650ddb0b013874751f2ca38727bd9afe884.gif

Also for 69 Summon Succubus an update has been released! The cute wolf Lucia has been added to the game.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41310298/655ea170a027e0d7adc70659f89072959de6e43b.png
